snippet.title: GreedFall II: The Dying World - Release Date Trailer (Gameplay Overview) | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10010517

Step into the world of GreedFall: The Dying World, an RPG that draws you into a journey where every choice shapes your fate and the fate of the people around you.
 
In this Gameplay Overview Trailer, discover what awaits you in the upcoming title. Explore its rich narrative and deep gameplay systems, uncover hidden secrets, experience meaningful choices that define your path, and meet a cast of charismatic companions who will accompany you on your adventure.
 
Wield your trusty sword, unleash powerful magic, or strike from afar with a bow. The flexible combat system allows you to seamlessly switch between a tactical pause for careful planning and fast-paced real-time combat.
 
From intense battles and powerful abilities to branching quests set in an immersive world that reacts to your decisions, this video offers a first glimpse of what awaits you in March.
 
GreedFall: The Dying World is set to release on PlayStation®5 on March 12.
